name: jev-gate
description: Gate agent tool calls before they run: plain-code lock rules ask before dangerous commands, a REUSE ledger stops unchanged expensive re-runs, and TypeSafe Jev judges the gray zone. Runs in shadow mode first (hooks + review skill).

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API Key
typesafe_api_key.description: API key for the TypeSafe Jev model that judges gray-zone tool calls. Without it, only the lock rules and the REUSE ledger run.

mode.title: Gate mode
mode.description: shadow: only lock rules act, everything else is logged. enforce: also apply Jev asks and REUSE denials. Switch only after reviewing shadow data (gate-review skill).
